title: Vector Quality Orchestrator: config-triggered offline recall/precision sweep and drift detective
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Problem: Configuration or model updates (embedding model version, quantization profile, reranker score normalization, index parameters) occasionally introduce silent regressions in recall/precision for important customer cohorts. Current protections are ad-hoc: a few canned smoke probes and manual spot-checks. We need an orchestrated, config-triggered system that runs prioritized offline evaluations and drift checks automatically when changes that can affect vector quality are proposed or deployed.
proposal_summary: Build a Vector Quality Orchestrator (VQO) that listens to config and model change events (PRs, platform config changes, release tagging) and spawns a prioritized offline evaluation sweep. The sweep includes: - cohort-weighted recall/precision & nDCG across critical customers - distribution-shift metrics (cosine shift quantiles, UMAP/clustering-based centroid drift) - backing store telemetry (index recall by shard/hot-cold buckets) - synthetic adversarial probes for edge cases - a rollback recommendation signal (pass/warn/fail) that gates CI or triggers canary hold. VQO will produce a structured report + dashboard and create automated Linear tickets for failures above thresholds.
milestones: M1: Event hooks & change detector (PR, config, model registry) - spike complete
M2: Batch evaluation runner + cohort prioritizer (kube job template + resource sizing)
M3: Metrics library: recall/precision/nDCG, cosine shift quantiles, cluster drift score
M4: Synthetic probe generator and adversarial sample harness
M5: Report generation, CI gating integration, dashboard panels and alerting
M6: Soft rollout on shadow CI for 2 weeks, then enable blocking for P1 changes
acceptance_criteria: A1: On model or config change event, VQO triggers jobs for top-10 prioritized cohorts with no manual steps
A2: For each cohort VQO produces: recall@1/5/10, precision@1/5/10, nDCG, cosine shift percentiles, and a single pass/warn/fail verdict
A3: Verdict rules are parametrizable and documented; default rules catch >=3% recall drop or >=5% increase in false positives for high-impact cohorts
A4: CI integration: a failing verdict can be configured to block merge for changes labeled 'vector-impacting'
A5: Generated report includes links to diffed anchor examples, top regressed queries, and a reproducible job ID for replay
A6: Dashboard panel (Console) surfaces per-model, per-cohort historical trend and the last VQO run artifacts
tech_notes: Implementation will use existing offline eval harness (batch workers in k8s) and extend it with a cohort prioritizer that weights by customer traffic and past sensitivity
Use importance-weighted recall so customers with skewed workloads are represented; store base snapshots for each model release to compute delta
Compute distribution shift with two complementary signals: cosine distance quantiles over random sample and UMAP+cluster centroid drift for semantic changes
Synthetic probe generator will mutate queries with common perturbations (typos, paraphrase via small LLM, token-drop) and include hand-curated adversarial templates from support triage
Orchestrator will emit structured JSON reports into S3 with metadata tags (model, quantization, config, PR id, commit sha) and create a summary artifact in the evals bucket
CI gating will be opt-in per repo via a small webhook + GitHub check that reads VQO verdicts; initial rollout only for internal repos and select customer-facing routes
runbook_summary: If VQO emits a failing verdict for a production model: 1) Create incident ticket and tag model-owner 2) Run replay job with previous release snapshot and compare diffs 3) If regression reproducible, block rollout and kick rollback pipeline; otherwise, create triage task for model calibration or config tweak
implementation_notes: Spike found that running full cohort sweeps for all changes is expensive; default to top-N prioritized cohorts and sample-based recall estimation
Use incremental evaluation (only requests whose index/embedding seeds changed) where possible to reduce cost
Plan to reuse existing KV-cache of eval queries to avoid regen for every run
Add graceful degradation: if runner resources constrained, run synthetic probes + smoke recall only and mark full-sweep as delayed
